coverage_rows.canon_label: concern record as first-class owned entity
exact_items: `concern` should be a first-class record, not just a field buried in review/alert logic
Concern records should carry identity, scope, severity, category, owner, lifecycle state, meaning/summary, linkage to evidence/artifacts/history/source records, visibility/attention flags
Canonical concerns should be created by runtime, package overseer, seam overseer, corroboration outcome, graph patch/state-transition logic

coverage_rows.canon_label: override-display / settings hierarchy tokens to retire
exact_items: Retire/replace legacy locality tokens with explicit scope labels: `Inherited`, `Explicit`, `Computed`
Treat `Runtime only` as computed truth, not user configuration

coverage_rows.canon_label: projection consumers and widget shell contract
exact_items: Orchestrator widgets should consume stable shared projections rather than raw event streams or bespoke queries
widget shell needs widget identity/type, scope, filter/sort/display config, projection ref
Run Summary, Seam Summary, Concern Summary, Account / Usage Pressure, Recent Major Events should be broadly reusable across Orchestrator / Dashboard / Projects

coverage_rows.heading_hint: Action-gating direction under degraded projections now clarified
exact_items: Actions that change execution/promotion/recovery/approval truth require fresh-enough projection state
UI should explain gating inline: what is stale, why it matters, what the user can do next
Projection health becoming an operational concern must mint a real concern rather than stay a silent widget problem
